visualReview.notes: Inspected all52 current portable/shared/medium-fi/native frames in nine labeled contact sheets, plus full-resolution native facade, stair, Forum, belfry and courtyard views. Seven-bay front, pale base, open stair rails/landing, recessed portal, three deep rear arch pockets, open two-stage belfry, clock/cornices, corner crenellations, tiled roofs and original narrow court read coherently. Ordinary pictures and standard PMTiles guided one continuous author/inspect/fix round; sculpture, heraldry and inscriptions are not copied.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Seven existing256px material graphs: stucco, stone_limestone, tile_ceramic, storefront, wood_plain, brick and stone_ashlar. Seven nearby draws/one skyline, metric UVs, linear tints and separate POSITION/NORMAL streams. No embedded image, private atlas or new graph. Each used graph reads once; all model geometry is released at unload. CPU/GPU accounting matches.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs997/3821/5933/6497 triangles. Initial skyline+district453460bytes; closeup615160bytes. Skyline keeps the complete main/corner/clock-tower silhouette, both physical open belfry stages, the rear arch pockets, court and coarse supported three-tread stair proxies. It omits small fenestration, nearby portal recess, pilasters, rails and clock-face detail. District uses12 treads per flight; street24; closeup28. Synthetic contexts test coherence/LOD/tier behavior, not native fit.

geographicReview.notes: Relation1691910 fixes the connected Senatorio/Tabularium parent. Integral ways123817461,123817462 and123817559 locate the corner and central clock towers. X northeast along the long central piazza edge; Z northwest toward the piazza. Signed axes baked east/up/south, heading0. Conservatori/Caffarelli, Nuovo, Aracoeli, surrounding ruins and city buildings remain independent. Original standard Protomaps20261020 / Mapzen grid retained. Outside piazza provider[0,13] gives 46.75355052584945m datum. Parent boundary grades -9.159..-0.794m; closed foundation-9.409m. Rear levels approximate the steep Forum slope. Court and piazza ground, independent neighbors, roads and water retained; no bespoke terrain or flattening. Historical thresholds, exposed basements and accessibility approximate. Initial native terrain/ownership inspected: both stair feet and the central landing are supported, the narrow court remains open, all four owned map records are replaced and independent structures/roads/water remain. Coarse rear levels, basement exposure and historic thresholds remain approximate. All four owned map records are replaced;2509 resident and2941 wider independent buildings, original narrow courtyard/piazza, terrain, roads and127008.089m² water remain. Failure keeps all2513 originals; all LOD/failure/unload cases restore ground/water and release geometry.

fidelityReview.notes: Recognizable medium-fi exterior with approximate architectural levels and hidden roof/bay inventory. Original coarse ground falls-.794..-9.159m around the mapped parent relative to the outside piazza datum. Front floor+.25m gives about1m of low-side plinth exposure; foundation-9.409m supports the Forum edge. Rear arches/levels approximate the sampled slope, not surveyed archaeology. Small capitals, roof figures, medieval crenellations, clock markings, thresholds and accessibility are simplified. No copied sculpture/inscriptions/heraldry, furnished galleries or reconstructed ancient interior. Some detail views crop far edges or tower top; whole/turntable views cover the envelope. Flat synthetic planes bury lower basement arches and grade-specific foundations. Native procedural ruins/neighbors can occlude lower Forum details; they stay independent. Physical phone/laptop and dense-city timings remain pending.

checks.notes: 161 actual mesh/contact probes and all six GLB pins pass; strict LOD caps, finite attributes, shared bindings and separate vertex streams checked.
